build_note: Season 16: Yun Tal Wildarrows gives 0% crit (pure AS). Build RFC second for 25% crit, then Collector for 50% crit before IE (75% total, IE fully active). R (Featherstorm) invincibility on demand is ARAM's best defensive ADC ability - use it to dodge every ult and engage.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th - Feathers bounce through tanks for good damage
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies - never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 4th replaces The Collector - still hits 50% crit for IE
kit_notes: Auto-E-auto pattern: autos plant feathers, E pulls them back rooting caught enemies. Double Daggers (Q) fires two feathers - use before E for maximum feather recall. R Featherstorm: INVINCIBLE during - use it to dodge any CC or burst. Rakan passive (Lovers' Leap) only if Rakan is your support.
aram_specific: Time R to dodge the enemy's biggest ability (Malphite R, Amumu R, Lux R). Never pre-cast R - wait to see the threat. Plant feathers with autos first, then use E to pull them back through grouped enemies for AOE root. Crowd the middle of ARAM for maximum feather coverage.
